verdict.rationale: Moss documents adding and upserting documents, bringing your own vectors via a `custom` model, attaching metadata (used for filtering), and fetching specific docs. Together these give a programmatic way to load vectors plus metadata, but nothing in the evidence describes a bulk import/export feature or a documented file format. Fetching specific docs is not a bulk export path. Missing for 10: a documented bulk-import file format (e.g. JSONL/Parquet), any bulk-export or dump capability for vectors and metadata, and hands-on corroboration.
